question: Show all clients
sql: SELECT client_id, client_name, status FROM clients;

question: Show active clients
sql: SELECT client_id, client_name, status FROM clients WHERE status = 'active';

question: Show all assets
sql: SELECT asset_id, client_id, asset_name, asset_type FROM assets;

question: Show all server assets
sql: SELECT asset_id, client_id, asset_name, asset_type FROM assets WHERE asset_type = 'server';

question: Show all critical findings
sql: SELECT finding_id, title, severity, status FROM findings WHERE severity = 5;

question: Show all high severity findings
sql: SELECT finding_id, title, severity, status FROM findings WHERE severity >= 4;

question: Show open critical findings
sql: SELECT finding_id, title, severity, status FROM findings WHERE severity = 5 AND status = 'open';

question: How many findings are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS finding_count FROM findings;

question: How many critical findings are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS critical_finding_count FROM findings WHERE severity = 5;

question: Show findings for client Acme
sql: SELECT f.finding_id, f.title, f.severity, f.status FROM findings f JOIN client_findings cf ON f.finding_id = cf.finding_id JOIN clients c ON cf.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_name = 'Acme';

question: Show critical findings for client Acme
sql: SELECT f.finding_id, f.title, f.severity, f.status FROM findings f JOIN client_findings cf ON f.finding_id = cf.finding_id JOIN clients c ON cf.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_name = 'Acme' AND f.severity = 5;

question: Show assets belonging to Acme
sql: SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_name, a.asset_type FROM assets a JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_name = 'Acme';

question: Show findings affecting each asset
sql: SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_name, f.finding_id, f.title, f.severity FROM assets a JOIN asset_findings af ON a.asset_id = af.asset_id JOIN findings f ON af.finding_id = f.finding_id;

question: Show critical findings affecting assets
sql: SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_name, f.finding_id, f.title, f.severity FROM assets a JOIN asset_findings af ON a.asset_id = af.asset_id JOIN findings f ON af.finding_id = f.finding_id WHERE f.severity = 5;

question: Count findings by severity
sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS finding_count FROM findings GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity DESC;

question: Count findings by status
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS finding_count FROM findings GROUP BY status;

question: Show the top 5 most severe findings
sql: SELECT finding_id, title, severity, status FROM findings ORDER BY severity DESC, finding_id LIMIT 5;

question: Show clients with their asset count
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.client_name, COUNT(a.asset_id) AS asset_count FROM clients c LEFT JOIN assets a ON c.client_id = a.client_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.client_name;

question: Show clients with critical finding count
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.client_name, COUNT(cf.finding_id) AS critical_finding_count FROM clients c JOIN client_findings cf ON c.client_id = cf.client_id JOIN findings f ON cf.finding_id = f.finding_id WHERE f.severity = 5 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.client_name;

question: Show assets with open critical findings
sql: SELECT a.asset_id, a.asset_name, f.finding_id, f.title FROM assets a JOIN asset_findings af ON a.asset_id = af.asset_id JOIN findings f ON af.finding_id = f.finding_id WHERE f.severity = 5 AND f.status = 'open';
